profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its SEC filings carry CIK 0000051143 and ticker IBM, and the company reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The portion of its website covered here focuses on governance, risk, and compliance software, though IBM operates across a much broader range of enterprise technology markets.

IBM's primary GRC offering is IBM OpenPages, which the company describes as a scalable, AI-powered platform for managing risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution. The platform is available on any cloud or on-premises and uses a modular architecture that allows organizations to deploy only the components they require. The site notes that embedded AI automates classification and issue creation, and that OpenPages can integrate with watsonx.ai or third-party models through an API-based architecture. The company also references an OpenPages MCP Server intended to let AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects within governed workflows. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in its Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and Citi is cited as a customer that used OpenPages to automate internal audit processes with AI and machine learning.

IBM also tracks two additional AI products in the held facts: IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, documentation, and EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026, and IBM watsonx, a broader enterprise AI platform described as model-agnostic and inclusive of agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection capabilities.
